title: from_cellranger_multi_to_h5mu
description:
Converts the output from cellranger multi to a single .h5mu file.
By default, will map the following library type names to modality names:
  - Gene Expression: rna
  - Peaks: atac
  - Antibody Capture: prot
  - VDJ: vdj
  - VDJ-T: vdj_t
  - VDJ-B: vdj_b
  - CRISPR Guide Capture: crispr
  - Multiplexing Capture: hashing
  
Other library types have their whitepace removed and dashes replaced by
underscores to generate the modality name.

Currently does not allow parsing the output from cell barcode demultiplexing.

dataset input.title: Dataset input
dataset input.description: Dataset input using nf-tower "dataset" or "data explorer". Allows for the input of multiple parameter sets to initialise a Nextflow channel.

param_list.description: Dataset input can either be a list of maps, a csv file, a json file, a yaml file, or simply a yaml blob. The names of the input fields (e.g. csv columns, json keys) need to be an exact match with the workflow input parameters.

input.description: Input folder. Must contain the output from a cellranger multi run.
input.help_text: type: `string`, multiple: False, required, direction: `input`, example: `['input_dir_containing_modalities']`

output.description:
Locations for the output files. Must contain a wildcard (*) character,
which will be replaced with the sample name.

sample_csv.description: CSV file describing the sample name per output file

uns_metrics.description: Name of the .uns slot under which to QC metrics (if any).

output_filtered_data.description:
If enabled, read the per-sample filtered count matrices
(per_sample_outs/{sample}/count/sample_filtered_feature_bc_matrix.h5)
instead of the aggregated raw count matrix
(multi/count/raw_feature_bc_matrix.h5).

output_compression.description:
Compression format to use for the output AnnData and/or Mudata H5 files.
By default no compression is applied.

nextflow input-output arguments.title: Nextflow input-output arguments
nextflow input-output arguments.description: Input/output parameters for Nextflow itself. Please note that both publishDir and publish_dir are supported but at least one has to be configured.
